classification.difficultyReason: Use equal marked sides to construct and solve an equation with the pronumeral on both sides.

spec.description: Unshaded wide rectangle with labels outside the top and bottom edges, matching double ticks on those edges, matching single ticks on the vertical sides, and a bottom-left right-angle marker. Decorative blue outlines are changed to house black.
spec.mathematics: The top side is x+25 and the equal bottom side is 8x-10. No units are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and markings are visible.

answer.worked:
The marked opposite sides are equal.

$$\begin{align*}x+25&=8x-10\\25&=7x-10\\35&=7x\\x&=5\end{align*}$$

Check: $5+25=30$ and $8\times5-10=30$.
